'''Rojo Barant''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] and member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. He was stationed at [[Edan Base]] during an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] siege of the facility on [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]].

==Biography==
Rojo Barant was a Rebel scout stationed at Edan Base, on Edan II. Between patrols, he often hung out in the landing bay, working on his [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]]. When a sentry on [[Sentry Post A9]] noticed that something entered the atmosphere, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Drayson (Rebel)|Drayson]] was immediately informed. He then requested Barant, to check this crashed [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] out. It turned out to be a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]].<ref name="IAG" />

==Personality==
Rojo Barant never talked much and never saw much reason to. Most of the time, he did not have anyone to talk to. He had a strong sense of humor, which frequently showed through. He was tough and proud of his abilities. He spent his days under the high, wide skies of virgin [[Planet/Legends|planets]], pitting himself against the wilderness. Barant was open to unexplored planets, discovering the dangers and learning how to deal with them. He figured out how to survive the strange weather, dangerous beasts, and rugged terrain of whole new worlds.<ref name="IAG" />

He would have still be doing that if the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] had let him. However, the Empire had cut back on exploration, citing high costs. Barant believed that freedom was an artifact of a frontier, people could not be controlled if they could always move freely. Furthermore, he felt that if someone wanted to impose tyranny on a galaxy, the way to do it would be to stop people from moving by closing the frontier. Faced with this realization, Barant saw no alternative but to join the Rebellion. He knew a dozen planets like the back of his hand and had the skills to survive anywhere. Whether it was setting up on an ice planet or navigating through hazardous landscapes, Barant became an invaluable asset to the Alliance.<ref name="IAG" />

==Equipment==
Rojo Barant's equipment consisted of a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]], a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blastor pistol]], and a [[Knife/Legends|knife]]. He also carried two [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]] and a week's worth of concentrated [[Ration pack/Legends|ration]]. Additionally, he had 1,000 credits on hand for any necessary expenses.<ref name="IAG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rojo Barant was introduced as the playable character in the story ''[[Escape Pod Down]]'' for [[Introductory Adventure Game]], a starting to the D6 role-playing system from [[West End Games]]. His [[Gender/Legends|gender]], age, height, and weight were left blank to fill out for the roleplayer.<ref name="IAG" />
